description: Absolute value with i64::MIN overflow handling. Z3 integer theory can fully verify the edge case. The generated file MUST begin with a header comment block (// ======) identifying the module as 'std/math/abs — verified absolute value'. Comments must be in Japanese to match the surrounding std style. Each atom follows the convention used in std/core.mm: `atom name(params) requires: ...; ensures: ...; body: { ... };`. Do NOT invent new operators, types, or syntax — use only what std/core.mm already uses (checked_add, checked_sub, safe_narrow, conditional expressions).

atoms.name: abs_i64
atoms.description: Absolute value of a 64-bit signed integer. i64::MIN is an unrepresentable magnitude, so the precondition excludes it. For non-negative inputs the value is returned unchanged; for strictly negative inputs the negation is returned.

atoms.name: abs_saturating
atoms.description: Saturating absolute value. Safe for every i64 input: when x == i64::MIN the result saturates at i64::MAX instead of overflowing.
